memory: You once said something completely ordinary and somehow I remembered it for months.
This was one of the days I caught myself smiling at my phone.
I never told you this, but this became one of my favorite photos.
There was a message I read so many times the screen dimmed before I finished.
I still remember the exact way you typed when you were sleepy.
Somewhere in my head there is a whole folder just for your laugh.
I once stayed up later than I should have, just to say goodnight properly.
You became part of my routine before I even noticed it happening.
I saved a screenshot of something ordinary because it felt like it mattered.
There is a version of a Tuesday that I only remember because of you.
I rehearsed a reply for ten minutes and then just sent 'haha okay'.
I remember exactly where I was the first time you said something that stuck.
Coffee started tasting like a good idea because of a conversation we had.
I kept a bad photo of you because the caption underneath it was worse.
Some nights the only good part was reading 'goodnight' from you.
